purpose: Reproduce unread-buffer capture mismatch as a known class, validate an opt-in bounded drain candidate, then classify a deterministic N5 child-loss interval with the qualified stage counters

cases: abort: pause owned tcpdump, send16 known UDP packets, signal stop before resume; expect incomplete file/filter counts but native/receiver16
drain: fresh owned fixture, same pause/send16, resume before bounded stable-equal counter check and stop; require final footer/file/native/receiver agreement

capture_drain_candidate.criteria: two unchanged captured==filter snapshots, zero kernel drops, same owned PID/start identity; final footer/file gate unchanged

live_case.placement: one third of source duration after host observation of measurement marker; not a command phase barrier

prerequisites: capture probe passes both known cases
eight runtime hashes match previously tested SDK/ROS build
source and plan committed before execution
analysis: Retain all original verdicts/errors and prior failed PCAP gate; no retry/replacement
Stop before live case if capture probe prerequisites fail
Use unchanged >=1s fully observed source-gap and active event analysis plus qualified pre-root counter correlation
Also retain deterministic child-loss readbacks and VM install/restore brackets; analyze settled interval from install-end+500ms to restore-begin-100ms
Require positive selected PASS counts, no selected source CONTROL tap observation in settled interval and restored traffic; record mismatches as failure, no threshold adjustment
Root counters cover whole interface; do not assign per-packet CONTROL loss
Require complete diagnostics and retain any final PCAP population failure without rescue
Audit closed immutable command journals and single SDK handoffs, preserve UNKNOWNs/skips/sensor deficits
limits: Synthetic paused recorder proves a class, not historical two-record cause
Live stability snapshots cannot prove no later arrival; final PCAP footer/file check remains authoritative
SIGUSR1 and observers add work after measurement/before stop
Known whole-endpoint child loss is not full N4 admission/dispatch/result-commit phase qualification
Permanent-neighbor/TC PASS/drain are diagnostic candidates; defaults unchanged
No unique historical cause, physical delivery/realtime, security parity or performance/M3 acceptance claim
Only owned disposable containers/processes modified; no host network or SRT/runtime policy changes
